name: clawdcursor
stderr:
Start here:
  clawdcursor doctor          check and set up
  clawdcursor agent           run, with a live log of every action
  clawdcursor task "<task>"   test an agent

Usage: clawdcursor [options] [command]

🐾 Desktop control for AI agents: an MCP tool layer your agent drives

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  agent [options]           Start the clawdcursor daemon (MCP over HTTP; your
                            own agent drives the tools)
  start [options]           [deprecated — use `clawdcursor agent`] Start the
                            Clawd Cursor agent
  doctor [options]          🩺 Diagnose setup: version, consent, screen capture,
                            accessibility, permissions. Driving clawdcursor over
                            MCP needs no doctor: consent + (macOS) `grant` is
                            the whole setup.
  task [options] <task...>  🧪 Test clawdcursor as the only tool an agent has:
                            your Claude Code or Codex (your subscription, no API
                            key) does <task> with clawdcursor and ends with PASS
                            or FAIL (exit 0 / 1). Add-on: downloaded on first
                            use, after asking
  logs [options]            📜 Show the logs readably: tool calls with outcome,
                            code and step timings; stop, pause, refusals, server
                            start and exit. Add-on: downloaded on first use,
                            after asking
  status                    📊 Check readiness status (consent, permissions)
  versions                  📦 List every copy of clawdcursor on this machine
                            (global install, Claude Desktop extension, Claude
                            Code plugin) and flag old ones
  update                    ⬆️  Update the global npm install to the latest
                            version, then list the other copies (Desktop
                            extension, Claude Code plugin) that need their own
                            update
  grant                     🔐 Request macOS permissions (triggers system
                            permission dialogs)
  stop [options]            Stop every running Clawd Cursor instance; agents
                            stay stopped until `clawdcursor resume`
  resume [options]          Continue a task the daemon paused for you (same as
                            the on-screen Resume), or --end it; a stdio MCP
                            server's pause is answered on its card. After a
                            stop, gives control back.
  uninstall                 Remove all Clawd Cursor config, data, and skill
                            registrations
  mcp [options]             Run as MCP tool server over stdio (for Claude Code,
                            Cursor, Windsurf, Zed)
  serve [options]           [deprecated — use `clawdcursor agent`] Start the
                            tool server only
  report [options]          Report the last session (or agent task) to the
                            clawdcursor team. Shows a preview first; no typed
                            text, clipboard or screenshots.
  consent [options]         Manage desktop control consent (required before
                            MCP/REST use)
  optout                    Turn off anonymous error reports (see `clawdcursor
                            telemetry` for what they contain)
  optin                     Turn anonymous error reports back on
  telemetry                 Show whether anonymous error reports are on, and
                            exactly which fields they send
  register-skill            (Re)register clawdcursor as a skill in your AI
                            agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Cursor)
  help [command]            display help for command
